prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: landscape presentation graphic, aspect ratio 2:1, high resolution.
Primary request: An editorial print diagram explaining generation versus verification. Two equal large rectangular colored paper fields with a generous narrow central gap. Left muted teal, right soft yellow. Warm off-white paper #F8F5EE background, fine paper grain, near-black printed ink, restrained vermilion red feedback arrow. Flat front-on, precise alignment, tiny hand-cut paper edge irregularities, minimal shallow contact shadow. Bold clean Archivo-like grotesque type, readable at presentation size. No people, robots, photos, 3D, decorative scraps, or computer-window chrome.
Composition: two side-by-side fields filling most of the canvas with generous outer margins. LEFT top heading "Generation" and subtitle "writes the code". Inside left field one ivory paper sheet headed "Coding agent", then four clearly separated horizontal lines of text: "Skills — How we build"; "Rules — What's allowed"; "Ticket — What's asked"; "Docs — How it works". RIGHT top heading "Verification" and subtitle "checks the code". Inside right field one ivory paper sheet headed "Code review agent", then four clearly separated horizontal lines with black checkmarks: "Skills applied"; "Rules followed"; "Ticket satisfied"; "Docs consistent".
Between the two fields, a black horizontal arrow points RIGHT labeled "Code". Below it, a vermilion horizontal arrow points LEFT labeled "Feedback". Both arrows must be entirely within the central gap and labels readable; choose a wide enough gap. Preserve these exact directions.
All text spelled exactly as supplied. Large titles, strong hierarchy, no additional text or title across the top, no footers, no brand or watermark. Crisp paper-and-ink editorial aesthetic, sparse intentional layout.
